messages:
incident-bot: Pager: Verdant Health (dedicated-vpc-3) high tail latency > 1k requests in last 5m. Severity: P2. Link: <https://incidents.redwood/3429876543>
Priya Nair: ack, looking. What’s the impact on client SLA and are they seeing errors or just latency?
Jamie Chen: Verdant CS says 500s are low (<0.1%) but p95/p99 for generate tokens up to 3.2s. Throughput is normal. Observed continuous batching sizes spiking ~2.5x. GPU utilization sat at 98% on pool dedicated-vpc-3.
Alex Soto: logs show scheduler backlog growth on tenant_id=verdant-42. Queue wait times up to 1.6s. load pattern: many short requests with high max_new_tokens (<=1024). Likely batch size aggregation causing long wait for fill.
Priya Nair: ok can we reduce max_batch_tokens or change max_wait_ms for that tenant only? Need to avoid global impact.
Jamie Chen: we have per-tenant knobs. Recommending temp change: set max_batch_tokens=256, min_batch_tokens=1, max_wait_ms=25, priority_preempt=true. This should reduce wait + smaller batches -> higher token cost but lower tail latency.
Alex Soto: also throttle background inference for non-critical routes from Verdant. They have two routes: /generate and /summary, summary can be deprioritized.
Priya Nair: do it. Jamie can you run the change and post the CLI? I’ll message Verdant CS.
Jamie Chen: running update now. CLI:
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/tenants/verdant-42/config \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"scheduler": {"max_batch_tokens": 256, "min_batch_tokens": 1, "max_wait_ms": 25, "priority_preempt": true}, "route_overrides": {"/summary": {"priority": "low"}}}'
```
deploy-bot: config update accepted, job 67321 queued
deploy-bot: job 67321 succeeded in 18s, applied to pool dedicated-vpc-3
Jamie Chen: change applied. Observability: within 30s p95 dropped from 3.2s -> 1.1s, p99 from 4.6s -> 1.9s. GPU utilization fell to ~74%.
Priya Nair: nice. Can we make this a canary for 10m then either keep or roll-back to optimized settings? Also need to update runbook and notify Verdant.
Alex Soto: canary is fine. I'll keep an eye on cost impact; token cost increased ~12% since smaller batches.
Jamie Chen: noting in thread for ops runbook: temp-verdant-surge-3429876543.
Verdant CS (via DM): thanks, seeing big improvement in UI load times. They request ETA for full mitigation.
Priya Nair: reply that we’re keeping changes for next 30m, monitoring. If stable, we’ll make them persistent with follow-up to engineer-led tuning to find middle ground (e.g., dynamic adaptive batching).
Morgan Lee: @Priya I’m coming on in 40m, I can take over monitoring and follow-up with Verdant CS.
Priya Nair: thanks, Morgan. Handoff summary: issue = dedicated-vpc-3 tenant verdant-42 high tail latency due to large batch fill times. Mitigation = per-tenant scheduler knobs adjusted (max_batch_tokens->256, min->1, max_wait_ms->25, priority_preempt->true), deprioritized /summary route. Metrics improved. Keep canary 10m, then decide persist vs revert. Contact Verdant CS and update runbook.
Morgan Lee: acked. If p99 rises >3s or errors >0.5% -> page me and escalate to infra oncall.
Jamie Chen: adding a short-term alert: if queue_wait_avg_1m > 800ms for tenant=verdant-42 -> page Morgan
incident-bot: Alert rule created: queue_wait_avg_1m > 800ms -> page Morgan Lee
Alex Soto: logging command used for debugging if needed:
```text
kubectl logs -n serving scheduler-pod-7 -c tenant-router | grep verdant-42 | tail -n 200
```
Priya Nair: leaving notes for runbook and postmortem template. Assigning follow-up: action_owner=Alex, tasks=[investigate adaptive-batching threshold, run replay tests, cost analysis].
Alex Soto: will take it. Anything else before handoff?
Verdant CS: appreciate the quick fix. Please keep us posted if you need to escalate to dedicated hardware or model quantization tradeoffs.
Morgan Lee: taking over. I’ll post an update 30m after this message.
Priya Nair: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Morgan Lee: (30m later) update: metrics stable. p95 ~1.0s, p99 ~1.7s. Keeping knobs for another 2h while Alex runs replay. Will open ticket for a longer-term adaptive batching rollout.
